notes: INSIDE half of the Human Volley Rack: a three-slot missile cradle with a feed chute on the right; a small missile slides into each slot as it charges (frames 0..5 seat 0,1,1,2,2,3; frame 5 = three seated, strip green), power coupling, repair hatch. fire: all three slots empty and the strip discharges. damaged: chute cracked, a missile jammed crooked, lamps dead; disabled: a missile jammed half way in the chute. Barrel layer human_volley_rack_barrel: a three-tube launcher head, a small missile in each tube; fire: the three leave one after another, smoke.
